title: HyperSORT: Self-organising Robust Training with Hyper-networks
mechanism: Hypernetwork maps a learned per-sample latent (L1-pulled to 0) to U-Net weights; systematic label styles and errors become outlying latents, latent 0 models the majority style.
adaptation: FiLM on the U-Net++ decoder driven by a 2-4 D learned latent per train cell instead of a full hypernetwork (repo needs ImFusion SDK key). Check whether latents cluster by source (label width 1.5 to 3.25 px) and outliers match audit cells; infer at latent 0 or per-source centroid (source-conditional prediction).
min_experiment: Arm: FiLM-latent U-Net++, 2 L1 weights, inference at 0 and source centroid. Baseline: house, 5 seeds. Metric: per-source crack IoU (BMRK, CFVS), clean-49 crack IoU / relF1@2, mIoU_rob. Kill: no centroid gain on BMRK/CFVS and no gain at latent 0.
evidence: R: AMOS with synthetic erosion/dilation styles formed separate latent clusters; on TotalSegmentator surfaced systematic biases and erroneous cases. Qualitative, 3D CT.
prior_overlap: none; source-conditional prediction and annotator modelling listed as never tried.
